wikitext: {{Npcbox | name = Lord Ello Ebonlocke | image = Lord Ello Ebonlocke.jpg | title = Mayor of Darkshire | gender = Male | race = Human | creature = Humanoid | level = 30 | faction = Alliance | affiliation = [[Stormwind (faction)|Stormwind]], [[Alliance]], [[Council of Darkshire]] | aggro = {{Aggro|1|-1}} | location = [[Darkshire Town Hall]], [[Duskwood]] | status = Alive | relatives = [[Commander Althea Ebonlocke|Althea Ebonlocke]] }} '''Lord Ello Ebonlocke''' is a [[human]] quest giver located in the [[Darkshire Town Hall]] in [[Duskwood]]. He is the mayor of [[Darkshire]], leading the [[Council of Darkshire]]. He is also a relative of [[Commander Althea Ebonlocke]], the leader of the [[Night Watch]].
